body:
📦 **Blocksail `b12a2f09`** — Merge codex/meadow-ship-luxury: three capped shipboard meals and original icons

Bring 106d50c5 into current Blocksail main. Preserve main6e1df3e7 provisioning fallback demand: each basic-recipe ingredient is counted once, so missing salt meat can still request salt fish. Exclude only luxury recipes from mandatory demand; do not restore the branch's older first-basic-only logic. Add targeted salt-fish fallback control (theo400,40 portions).

Three128px RGBA dish icons, recipe data, caps15/15/10%, exact calorie/stock accounting, independent white masters and prompts in ArtGallery ad6db9a. Sources remain separate from the locally modified Blockside submodule. No battle.html rebuild is required: ship recipes and images are served from Blocksail world/img.

Validation: merged image/hash checks, dishes/resources/classes ledgers, supply and consumption controls, node syntax, browser in-game seven-dish menu; full sailor30-day regression repeated against merged source. Parent pointers and remote push unchanged.

Refs TASK-1145

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
